ValidationRule.description: The stage "Approved by controller" could be selected only by controlling users
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Controlling User'
&& ISPICKVAL(Indexation_Status__c, "Approved by Controlling")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the stage to "Approved by Controller"
